contributions.detail: exact (154 rows, of which 153 carry an amount: p4 13,535.00 + p5 28,883.00 + p6 25,851.00 = 68,269.00 = the attachment's printed 'Contributions for Period Ending 6/16/14' $68,269.00 = stated_c $68,269.00). Line 94 (Ellen Brady, 5/2/14) has an EMPTY Amount cell on the source and is excluded; the filer's own printed total also excludes it, which is why the side still lands exactly.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The county form pages (3 Schedule A, 7 Schedule B) print SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE but carry only 'See Attached' - nothing to gate. The five attachment pages print NO per-page subtotal, only one grand total per side at the end of the last page (p6 $68,269.00; p9 $32,245.46); both equal the sum of all that side's rows EXACTLY, which is the only gate available and it holds on both sides.
itemized.escalation_note: p5 line 42 (Ellen Brady) Amount cell re-rendered at 600 dpi as a tight three-row crop, because a blank amount is the one thing a reconciliation cannot see: the cell is genuinely EMPTY on the page (occupation and employer are filled, amount is not). Left blank + needs_review rather than inferred. Pages 4-6 are landscape and needed +90 (CCW) rotation for this file.
itemized.notes: June 17, 2014 interim (the 'June 17 - seven days before a primary election' box is checked; amendment = No). Sim Gill, District Attorney. Both schedules read 'See Attached'; the itemization is a born-digital table on p4-6 (landscape, 154 contribution rows) and p8-9 (portrait, 62 expenditure rows). The county's black redaction box covers Mailing Address AND City on the contribution pages but NOT State or Zip Code, so donor_state is populated and donor_city is blank-because-redacted; ZIP was deliberately not recorded. On p4 line 1 the box is slightly misaligned and part of an address line shows - not transcribed. Two source properties worth flagging: (a) p5's last row and p6's first row are BOTH 'Abdul & Alia Rauf' dated 5/10/14 with the same ZIP but DIFFERENT amounts ($200.00 and $100.00) - transcribed as the two separate rows the source prints, not merged; (b) p6 carries three near-identical smoke-shop donors spelled three different ways on consecutive lines ('Haus of Hookahs', 'House of Hookah', 'Hause of Hookah'), each $500.00 with a different ZIP - kept verbatim. Line 138 (5/23/14 Sarvjit Gill) is the only out-of-state donor (CO). Line 148 is the filer's own aggregate line 'Miscellaneous Cash Contributions' with no state/ZIP.
